status_note: The locked direct full-loc Merge::mergeByDatatype function projection byte-matches for the enumerated state, but the ActionMergeType caller closure, public arbitrary-range interface and listed semantic branches are not closed.
architecture: synthetic little-endian 64-bit Architecture: const=0, other=1, unique=2, ram=3, register=4, stack=5, join=6, iop=7; byte-addressed spaces
compiler_spec: synthetic prototype named fixture, extrapop=0, empty input/output, no effect records, no symbols

analysis_options.entrypoint: direct function projection after high creation: Ghidra fd.getMerge().mergeByDatatype(fd.beginLoc(),fd.endLoc()); Rugra Merge::new().merge_by_datatype(&mut fd); this is not a proof of Rust ActionMergeType::apply
analysis_options.datatype_identity: one shared uint4 object, two structurally equal but pointer-distinct uint4 objects, and one shared same-address tie type
analysis_options.covers: same semantic point Covers on block 0 at each defining operation; Ghidra lazily derives them from the zero-input COPY graph, while the Rust fixture installs the corresponding point Cover before set_high_level
analysis_options.normalization: none; stdout is byte-diffed and both stderr streams must be empty
analysis_options.scale_axis: free Varnode count only: 1, 2, 32, 1024; eligible High count is fixed and deliberately not claimed as an eligible/cache scale proof

input_manifest.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON array, compact separators, ensure_ascii=false
cases: free register varnodes counts 1,2,32,1024 at offsets 0x1000+8*i, common TypeFactory uint4
eligible common-type written values unique:0x30@ram:0x8000, ram:0x20@ram:0x8001, register:0x10@ram:0x8002, disjoint point covers
Basic filters: implied register:0x40, proto-partial register:0x50, spacebase register:0x60
exact datatype identity: two structurally equal caller-owned uint4 TypeBase pointers at register:0x70 and register:0x80
stable same-address merge: common caller-owned type at register:0x90 defined at ram:0x8008 then ram:0x8009
observe survivor identity, all High assignments, instance order and count, merge groups, filter singleton state, mark clear state, and free High cardinality

decisive_semantics.references_and_outputs: MATCH for the fixture projection: survivor identity, every observed Varnode-to-High reference, instance count/order, merge groups, singleton filters and marks are compared; arbitrary range/output mutation remains MISMATCH
decisive_semantics.loop_bounds_and_order: MATCH for full beginLoc/endLoc with stable High dedup, exact pointer-type grouping, free counts 1/2/32/1024, reversed storage offsets across space ids, and same-address defining-op order
decisive_semantics.counters_and_accumulators: MATCH for speculative merge-group increments 0/1/2, free High cardinality and per-run reset; cache population/reuse counters are not observable and remain UNTESTED
decisive_semantics.sort_and_comparison_keys: MATCH for full storage-space ordering, reversed offsets, defining-op address tie-break and retained-side stability at identical storage; Cover first-block and null-def layers remain UNTESTED

coverage.direct_function_entrypoint_and_complete_: MATCH for the enumerated point-Cover fixture state
coverage.action_merge_type_caller_closure: MISMATCH: Rust ActionMergeType creates a fresh Merge and calls merge_all; locked Ghidra reuses Funcdata::getMerge and calls only mergeByDatatype, so prior phases and cache lifetime differ
coverage.arbitrary_start_end_iterator_range: MISMATCH: Rust exposes only the whole-bank call and cannot reproduce public Ghidra [startiter,enditer) selection/mutation
coverage.block_intersection_interior_and_boundary: UNTESTED: every legal Cover pair is disjoint at the coarse intersectList threshold
coverage.intersection_cache_move_and_later_lookup: UNTESTED: the three-High sequence does not prepopulate a high2-to-later candidate edge before high2 is merged
coverage.intersection_cache_clear_and_cross_call_: UNTESTED: the direct fixture constructs one fresh Merge per scale and does not observe clear or reuse across calls
coverage.merge_linear_in_place_vector_mutation: UNTESTED: mergeLinear is private in Rust and the caller-owned vector ordering is not exposed by the fixture
coverage.speculative_required_adjacent_guards: UNTESTED: typelock, addrtied, input, persist, extraout, namelock, illegal-input, isolated-symbol and two-piece rejection branches are outside this fixture
coverage.merge_test_required_shared_callers: UNTESTED: mergeOpcode/marker/adjacent callers and their rejecting mutation states are not exercised; only permissive MergeType values reach this helper
coverage.merge_test_basic_constant_annotation_ins: UNTESTED: caller-level free filtering and legal/implied/proto-partial/spacebase cases are covered, but constant, annotation and INSERT/hasCover combinations are not directly invoked
coverage.mark_dedup_preexisting_multi_instance_hi: UNTESTED: all initial eligible HighVariables are single-instance
coverage.dirty_varnode_cover_lazy_rebuild: UNTESTED on Rust: the fixture installs clean point Covers; production dirty-cover rebuild is outside the byte proof
coverage.dirty_flag_type_symbol_lazy_short_circui: UNTESTED: dirty-to-clean transitions and updateType/updateFlags/updateSymbol short-circuit state are not fully observed
coverage.eliminated_high_retirement_and_external_: MISMATCH/UNTESTED: Ghidra deletes the eliminated HighVariable; Rust Arc handles can retain it, and the fixture observes only live Varnode back-references
coverage.exact_cover_flags_num_merge_classes_and_: UNTESTED: projected instances/merge groups/back-references match, but all raw cover endpoints, High flags, numMergeClasses and drained source-High fields are not serialized
coverage.compare_high_all_keys_equal: UNTESTED: identical Cover/storage/null-def-or-def-address equivalence and sort stability at a completely equal comparator key are not separately constructed
coverage.defining_op_address_space_identity: MISMATCH/UNREPRESENTABLE: locked compareHighByBlock compares the defining PcodeOp's full Address including code-space index, while Rugra PcodeOp::get_addr returns an offset-only Address; all fixture definitions use ram so this difference is not exercised
coverage.stripped_datatype_identity: UNTESTED: only base uint types are used; updateType getStripped identity behavior for pointer/array/partial/enum types is outside the fixture
coverage.eligible_high_and_cache_scale: UNTESTED: scale increases only filtered free Varnodes; eligible High count is fixed
coverage.address_space_duplicate_numeric_id_total: UNTESTED and invalid in the synthetic Architecture
